syllabus: This case is affirmed upon the authority of Harte v. Kernochan, 103 U. S. 562, and other cases.
summary:
■APPEAL FROM THE CIRCUIT COURT -OF THE UNITED STATES FOR THE SOUTHERN DISTRICT OF ILLINOIS.

This was an action brought by citizens, owners of real estate and taxpayers' in Wayne County, Illinois, against the officers.of that county to have certain issues of bonds of that county cancelled as invalid, and an injunction issued to prevent the levy of taxes to pay any of the principal or interest upon them.
attorneys: Mr. H. Tompkins for appellants submitted on his brief., Mr. George A. Sanders, for appellees. Mr. T. G. Mather, Mr. J. A. Connolly and Mr. O. J. Bailey filed a brief for same.

opinions.author: Pee
opinions.text:
Pee Curiam.

The decree of the Circuit Court is affirmed upon the authority of Leach v. The People, 122 Illinois, 420; Harter v. Kernochan, 103 U. S. 562; Bonham v. Needles, 103 U. S. 648.

Affirmed,.
